> पुनरागमनम् · punarāgamanam — the return: the foundational compositional primitive of this repository. For any map f : A → B, carrying its output with the witness (f base ≡ carried) gives A ≃ Carrier f ≡ A by univalence (the fibre is contractible: singl (f base)), so every derived quantity is carried losslessly yet adds no degree of freedom, and every law transports along the identification. Source: punaragamana/ (branch punaragamana-carrier-law), Punaragamana.Carrier.

Commit `5fbaf718`.

Corrections outrank results here, and refuting your own claim is the most
respected act in this repository. By that standard these are the corpus's
most valuable object — and until this file existed they lived only in
`git log`, the one surface no arriving mind reads. A refutation nobody can
find is a claim still circulating.

Nothing here is counted or ranked. Read it as the record of what this
corpus has already stopped believing, so you do not spend a night
re-believing it.

## Using this against your own context

If a claim you are carrying appears here as struck, it is struck no matter
how many times your standing state has repeated it. That is not
hypothetical: on 2026-08-19/20 an agent's self-authored heartbeat block
carried `887641a7`'s struck collapse dichotomy through roughly twenty
cycles while the correction sat in the tree the whole time. The mechanism
that fires on the write is `.claude/hooks/struck-claims.sh`; this file is
its readable half, and any row here is a candidate row for that ledger.
